# Found It Marketing

> Digital marketing agency in Alexandria, Louisiana that builds digital empires for local businesses through custom business operating systems (Found It OS), Google Ads management, conversion-focused web design, SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). No long-term contracts; clients own their accounts, code, and data.

## Core Services

### Found It OS — Custom Business Operating Systems
- Point of sale, inventory, customers, service tickets, and website with a built-in AI — one system, built for one business at a time.
- The new system runs beside the old one, penny-matched nightly; the owner switches only when they say go. Zero downtime.
- Month-to-month, no contracts. Clients own the code and the data — if we part ways, the system stays theirs.

### Google Ads Management (PPC)
- Weekly optimization, real conversion tracking, and transparent reporting for local service businesses.
- Platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), YouTube Ads.
- Focus on cost-per-lead, lead quality, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Free audit. No contracts.

### Web Design & Development
- Custom, conversion-focused websites built on Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
- Mobile-first, fast-loading (Core Web Vitals focus), and engineered to turn visitors into calls.
- Clients own the code, domain, and hosting. Typical launch in 2 weeks.

### AI Search Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Get recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.
- Entity authority, answer-engine optimization, structured-data dominance, and local SEO.
- Targeting the "zero-click" future where AI synthesizes the answer.

### Social Media Management
- Done-for-you content and strategy. We create it, you approve it.
- Real content that builds authority and drives leads, measured by calls and bookings, not vanity metrics.

### Custom App Development
- Native-feeling iOS and Android apps with in-person blueprinting and fixed-price timelines.
- Clients own 100% of the codebase and intellectual property.

### AI Marketing Automation
- Custom AI systems for lead generation, instant follow-up, and automated appointment setting via AI voice and text agents.
- Local, done-for-you implementation. No software subscriptions or tech skills required.

## Service Areas

## Why Found It Marketing
- You own everything: your accounts, your code, your data.
- No long-term contracts. Month-to-month. Cancel anytime.
- A senior strategist on every account. No hand-offs to interns.
- Real local team in Alexandria, LA with a real phone number.
